newsitem.title: PERU: Peru mudslide buried 250-300 people - Fujimori.
newsitem.headline: Peru mudslide buried 250-300 people - Fujimori.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori said on Wednesday a mudslide that swept away two remote Andean villages had buried between 250 and 300 people.
"There are between 250 and 300 people buried under this immense amount of mud that we are seeing," Fujimori told local radio station Radioprogramas del Peru from the site.
Fujimori said 41 bodies had been recovered so far. An official at the local headquarters of the rescue operation said earlier that 47 had been found.
Fujimori said there were "few survivors" from the tragedy and warned there was a huge mass of mud at the site that could slide again.
The mountainside in southeastern Peru collapsed before dawn Tuesday after torrential rains, deluging the villages of Ccocha and Pumaranra at its foot with mud and rocks.
Inhabitants had been evacuated after weekend flooding, but their refuge in a fold of the mountain above the village put them in the path of the mudslide.
